intents_zh: 列出 EC2 漂亮表格
code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

aws ec2 describe-instances \
  --filters "Name=tag:Environment,Values={{tag_filter}}" \
  --query 'Reservations[].Instances[].[Tags[?Key==`Name`].Value|[0], InstanceId, InstanceType, State.Name, PrivateIpAddress, PublicIpAddress]' \
  --output table
summary_zh: EC2 列表依 tag 過濾並輸出表格
